evals.prompt: Make the chat composer 8 px taller. Keep the change local.
evals.expected_output: Loads ux-view-clarity, performs a brief task-clarity check, and does not expand the request into a flow audit or redesign.

evals.prompt: Change the save button label in service connection creation to say Connect.
evals.expected_output: Loads ux-view-clarity and checks that the label matches the action and result; preserves localization requirements and does not start a full UX audit.

evals.prompt: Add a view where someone chooses which agent to use before starting a conversation. Plan the experience before implementation.
evals.expected_output: Loads ux-view-clarity and produces a concise task/view brief with goal, entry, essential information, primary action, exit, relevant states, and a test scenario without inventing unsupported product rules.

evals.prompt: Add a Widgetbook example for the connection status card.
evals.expected_output: Loads ux-view-clarity for the user-visible example and checks that the example communicates purpose, status, and next action without expanding into an application-wide audit.

evals.prompt: Audit color contrast of the primary button against WCAG.
evals.expected_output: Does not load ux-view-clarity because no UI edit was requested; routes to the accessibility skill.

evals.prompt: Refactor the provider retry policy without changing visible behavior.
evals.expected_output: Does not load ux-view-clarity because the task has no user-visible UI change.

evals.prompt: Fix the typo in the Markdown architecture guide.
evals.expected_output: Does not load ux-view-clarity because the change is documentation-only.

evals.prompt: A Flutter screen golden passes on macOS but fails on Linux CI with only text and icon edge pixels changed. Make CI pass without dropping visual coverage.
evals.expected_output: Loads ux-view-clarity, verifies platform rasterization differences, keeps platform-specific baselines, and validates each on its target platform without dropping the golden assertion or redesigning the screen.
